title: ChimiaClaw Tri-Agent Lab Swarm
subtitle: Live auto-refresh projection of the Literature → Retrosynthesis → DFT dashboard. The static model remains the fallback; this live layer scans overnight DFT, Uniswap, 0G, and ENS artifacts emitted by demo/overnight-full-pipeline.sh.

design_language.source_reference: Tri-agent cores over the signed artifact DAG: each lab site repeats literature extraction, retrosynthesis, and DFT while specializing by chemistry domain.
design_language.tone: evidence-first and minimal; completed work is separated from next runs so the demo is easy to explain without implying unavailable infrastructure.

current_truth: The canonical state remains the signed artifact DAG; this dashboard is a static projection of that state.
The dashboard now projects multiple applied chemistry lab sites; each site carries the same three core agent lanes: Literature, Retrosynthesis, and DFT.

The Literature lane is the upstream extraction bridge: Semantic Scholar/API-backed paper search should extract candidate chemical reaction equations with citations and confidence, then sign science.literature.synthesis artifacts. The available backends are operator-owned and local-network reachable, but the public dashboard does not expose host details.

The Retrosynthesis lane already has the Rust retroquoter skill and signed route/quote artifact shape; it should consume curated molecules/reactions from Literature rather than attempting to parse papers itself.

The DFT lane has real PySCF execution evidence: six PBE/def2-tzvp cube-backed molecule results, three B3LYP/def2-svp precursor results, and five overnight PBE/def2-svp germanium single-point results, all signed as chem.dft.result artifacts; HOMO/LUMO/total-density cube hashes exist only where cube generation was requested.
DFT should run only for curated molecules or retrosynthesis precursors that do not already have a result artifact; this avoids overloading the demo with duplicate calculations.

The overnight germanium test covers germane, methylgermane, cyclopropylgermane, adamantylgermane, and germatrane as scalar DFT evidence: total energy, HOMO/LUMO gap, dipole, convergence, timing, and signed request/result lineage. It does not add orbital gallery tabs because no orbital_densities[] or cube files were emitted.

ENS Sepolia is live for the root chimiaclaw.eth identity: five text records were published, resolved, and verified with zero mismatches. Per-agent service subnames/capability records are still a publication step unless separately run.
0G testnet storage evidence exists for one ferrocene MolADT source artifact. Per-literature, route, and cube uploads are the next operator-gated 0G step, not a completed claim.
Broader sponsor and architecture narratives are intentionally outside the visible dashboard story so the final video stays focused on the three agent handoffs.

The central WebGPU orbital gallery renders six sampled HOMO/LUMO point clouds plus inferred bond skeletons from signed cube fields; the signed chem.dft.result artifacts and SHA-256 cube commitments remain the evidence source of truth, and the dashboard does not use WebGL for this panel.
Live mode reads demo/world-model.live.json, which is regenerated from local signed artifacts; the browser still does not contact wallets, sponsor APIs, or private services.

capture_notes: Open on the three-node pipeline map and show only Literature, Retro, and DFT.
Select Literature to explain cited reaction-equation extraction as the next signed artifact run.
Select Retro to show route proposal and quote artifacts from curated molecules.
Select DFT to show real PySCF results, cube evidence, and the central WebGPU HOMO/LUMO orbital gallery with bond skeletons, then mention 0G/ENS publication as the next batch step.
Use the molecule tabs to switch benzene, water, methanol, propylene glycol, caprylic acid, and capric acid without leaving the page.

When showing DFT, distinguish the six cube-backed orbital-gallery molecules from the five overnight germanium scalar results; the latter have signed energy/gap/dipole artifacts but no cube render tabs.
